newsitem.title: USA: Tee-Comm's distribution unit files Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Tee-Comm's distribution unit files Chapter 11.

text.p: A second U.S. unit of Tee-Comm Electronics Inc filed for Chapter 11 protection.

According to papers filed Friday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware, Tee-Comm Distribution Inc of Tonawanda, N.Y., listed assets of $10.0 million and liabilities of approximately $105 million. Tee-Comm Distribution is a distributor of satellite television signal receiving equipment, court papers say. On Tuesday, the AlphaStar Television Network unit of Stamford, Conn., filed for Chapter 11 protection in the same court.
